title: 음식 맛 말하기: 짜요, 싱거워요, 느끼해요
objective: Use 10 taste words in the polite -아요/어요 form (including ㅂ-irregular 싱거워요, 매워요), answer '맛이 어때요?' in one short sentence, and tell 싱거워요 (a complaint) apart from 담백해요 (a compliment).
summary: Learn ten everyday Korean taste words and use them to say how a dish tastes.

task.title: USE THE TASTE WORDS
task.line: Read each item, then write or choose the taste word that fits the food or the situation.

words.exampleMeaning: This rice cake isn't very sweet.

words.example: 국이 좀 짜요. 물 좀 주세요.
words.exampleMeaning: The soup is a bit salty. Could I have some water?

words.meaning: bland, not salty enough (a complaint; ㅂ-irregular: ㅂ → 워요)
words.exampleMeaning: The stew is a bit bland. Do you have salt?

words.meaning: spicy (hot), like chili pepper (ㅂ-irregular: ㅂ → 워요)
words.exampleMeaning: This tteokbokki is spicier than I thought.
The coffee is bitter because I didn't add sugar.

words.meaning: nutty, toasty (the good taste of sesame oil, sesame seeds, or roasted nuts)
words.exampleMeaning: It tastes nutty because I added sesame oil.

words.meaning: greasy, too oily or rich (a complaint)
words.exampleMeaning: The pizza is a bit greasy. Do you have pickles?

words.meaning: light and clean-tasting, not oily or heavy (a compliment)
words.exampleMeaning: This grilled fish isn't oily, so it tastes light and clean.

words.meaning: spicy and hot in a satisfying way (mostly for soups and broths)
words.exampleMeaning: I like it because the broth is nice and spicy.

exercises: Fill in the blank with the polite -아요/어요 form of the word in brackets: ①간장(soy sauce)을 조금만 넣어서 나물(seasoned vegetable side dish)이 좀 ____. (싱겁다) / ②이 수박(watermelon)은 정말 ____. (달다) / ③레몬차(lemon tea)가 좀 ____. (시다)
Put the words in the right order to make a sentence: 김치가 / 너무 / 매워요 / 이
Choose the best word for each food from this list — 써요, 고소해요, 느끼해요: ①한약(Korean herbal medicine) / ②볶은 땅콩(roasted peanuts) / ③치즈를 많이 올린 감자튀김(French fries with lots of cheese on top)
Your friend asks '맛이 어때요?'. Answer in one short Korean sentence: ①짬뽕(spicy seafood noodle soup) — the soup is spicy and hot in a good, satisfying way. / ②감자칩(potato chips) — there is too much salt.
Is the speaker complaining or praising the food? Write 'complaint' or 'praise': ①이 두부조림(braised tofu)은 좀 싱거워요. / ②이 백숙(boiled whole-chicken soup)은 담백해요. ③이 크림 파스타(cream pasta)는 너무 느끼해요.
answers: ① 싱거워요 ② 달아요 ③ 셔요 (시어요 is also correct)
① 써요 ② 고소해요 ③ 느끼해요
① (짬뽕이) 얼큰해요. (국물이 얼큰해요.) ② (감자칩이) 너무 짜요. (좀 짜요.)
① complaint ② praise ③ complaint
